hints: Use right-angled triangle $BOX$ to find $BX = 6\sin(\pi-2.5)$ and $OX = 6\cos(\pi-2.5)$.
Calculate $XC = 6 - OX$ and sum $\text{Arc } BC + BX + XC$.
walkthrough:
Calculate angle $\angle AOB$ in radians using $s = r\theta$:
$$\angle AOB = \frac{\text{Arc } AB}{r} = \frac{15}{6} = 2.5\text{ radians}$$

Determine the adjacent angle $\angle BOC$ and the length of arc $BC$:
$$\angle BOC = \pi - 2.5 \approx 0.6416\text{ radians}$$
$$\text{Arc } BC = r \times \angle BOC = 6(\pi - 2.5) \approx 3.850\text{ cm}$$

Use right-angled trigonometry in $\triangle BOX$ (where $OB = 6\text{ cm}$) to find $BX$:
$$BX = 6\sin(\pi - 2.5) \approx 3.591\text{ cm}$$

Find $OX$ and the remaining base segment $XC$:
$$OX = 6\cos(\pi - 2.5) \approx 4.807\text{ cm}$$
$$XC = OC - OX = 6 - 4.807 = 1.193\text{ cm}$$

Sum all three boundary lengths to find the perimeter of region $BXC$:
$$\text{Perimeter} = \text{Arc } BC + BX + XC = 3.850 + 3.591 + 1.193 = 8.634 \approx 8.63\text{ cm}$$
